title: From Restlessness to steadier practice
subtitle: A deliberate path through restlessness
description: Guru answers wandering with saint company, listening, and honest stillness. This path starts with short guidance, opens the topic fully, and then stays long enough with Gurbani to change pace.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Searching and ritual are not identical with peace.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Do not confuse spiritual activity with inward arrival.
